An oasis in centre town
May 2019 • Friends
Cục Gạch Quán on Đặng Tất Street is, in our opinion, the best restaurant in Vietnam - a long menu of authentic, superbly-executed home style dishes, served by knowledgeable staff in a charming home decorated like a middle-class house in South Vietnam in the 60’s. Others (like the Quán Bụi group) have tried to emulate this, but don’t come near. This Cục Gạch Café is not a restaurant; it’s just a café, focusing on serving coffees and juices. Food only consists of a few lunch sets, good but nothing special. The décor, however, is very stylish in an understated way, and the overall ambience is quite soothing. Cục Gạch means ‘brick’ in Vietnamese, and it shouldn’t cost you more than a brick VND to have lunch here.
